definitions.explanation: A large cicada with brown, opaque wings, one of the commonest cicadas in Japanese cities in midsummer.

examples.japanese: アブラゼミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鳴|な}いている→鳴く：04388_naku⟧。
examples.english: A large brown cicada is buzzing.
A large brown cicada was clinging to the tree trunk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧アブラゼミ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ジージー⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る→響き渡る：15059_hibikiwataru⟧。
examples.english: Once August comes, the jee-jee drone of cicadas rings out from the morning on.

notes:
Its call, written ジージー, is often compared to oil sizzling in a pan, one explanation offered for the name (⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧, oil). Unusually among cicadas, its wings are brown rather than clear.
